name: bk-mod-images
description: Draws pictures inline in the transcript on terminals that speak the kitty graphics protocol (kitty, Ghostty): Read results for PNG, JPEG and GIF, MCP image blocks, and pasted images; name and size elsewhere. BK fork of claude-mod-images.

maxRows.title: Picture height
maxRows.description: The most terminal rows a picture takes, its caption included, from 2 to 256. A short terminal gives a picture half its height at most.
